Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-demo / SIG kickoff — next steps and clarifying questions

Hi Aya and Tom,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — great conversation and good alignment on the integration pattern you described for clinical-notes ingestion. Per our ask on the call, attaching the SIG (v1.2) as the starting point and outlining a short list of clarifying questions so your security team can scope answers quickly. I cc'd Rishi (solutions) to help map evidence to each SIG section.

Priority asks (can you indicate "owned by MedNext" + estimated turnaround?):
- SOC 2 status: do you have a SOC 2 Type II report in the last 12 months? If not, Type I + timeline?
- HIPAA scope: will MedNext be the covered entity or business associate for this integration? Which environments (prod/uat) will process PHI?
- Data residency & GDPR: any EU customers we need to exclude or route to EU regions?
- Subprocessors: updated subprocessor list + contracts (redacted ok)
- Encryption & keys: evidence of encryption at rest and in transit; KMS provider + key rotation note
- Logging / audit: retention window for access logs and sample log entry (timestamped)

Timeline: we usually see security teams return a partially-completed SIG within 7–10 business days. If you prefer CAIQ instead, we can accept that — just flag which format you want to return.

Attachments:
- MedNext_SIG-v1.2.pdf (redwood stub) — master SIG file

Next steps: if useful, Rishi and I can schedule a 30-min Q&A with your security lead next week to walk the SIG. Otherwise send the prefills and we’ll follow up with the evidence map and any clarifying asks.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 17:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo / SIG kickoff — next steps and clarifying questions

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap and the SIG. I spoke with Tom and looped our security mailbox. Quick answers inline: 

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report (Jan 2026). I'll attach a redacted copy.
- HIPAA: MedNext will be the covered entity; our integrations will require Redwood to be a business associate for PHI flows. Production will process PHI; UAT does not.
- GDPR/Data residency: We have a small EU customer base; any PHI for EU residents will be redacted, but for non-PHI EU data we'd prefer EU region routing.
- Subprocessors: See attached subprocessor list (legal has redacted contractual ids).
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest with AWS KMS; TLS1.2+ in transit.
- Logging: Access logs retained 365 days; sample log extract can be provided.

We prefer to return the SIG PDF prefills; security asked whether Redwood could provide an evidence matrix mapping SIG sections to sample artifacts (that would speed our review). We can aim to return the prefills in 7 business days — target Fri 2026-08-29.

I'll attach the SOC2-redacted.pdf and subprocessors.csv to this thread. If Rishi can put together a simple evidence matrix template, that would be helpful.

Thanks,
Aya
Head of Product Security | MedNext Health
aya.tanaka@mednext.health
